title: Guaranteeing Hausdorff-Gromov-Hausdorff Equality for Metric Graphs
summary: We prove the equality of Hausdorff and Gromov-Hausdorff distance $d_{GH}(G, U) = d_{H}(G, U)$ for a metric graph $G$ and a subset $U \subseteq G$, given that the Hausdorff distance between $G$ and $U$ is attained not just near the leaves of $G$ and the Gromov-Hausdorff distance is not too big compared to the graph's systole.
